findings.finding: Core pagination fix verified correct by code inspection: page 1 replaces `listings`, page 2+ appends via functional setState, button hides once listings.length >= total (matches backend's real pagination.total field), and filterStore's existing setFilter behavior (reset page to 1 on non-page changes, preserve on page changes) is used unmodified.

Previously-flagged retry regression is fixed: the 'Try again' control on a failed subsequent-page fetch now calls `fetchListings` directly (re-fetches the same, still-failed page) instead of `handleLoadMore` (which would have incremented past the failed page and permanently skipped it).
findings.evidence: rentals/frontend/src/app/browse/page.tsx:167 (onClick={fetchListings}) vs :172-173 (onClick={handleLoadMore} only on the normal button)

findings.finding: Race condition edge case: if a user changes a filter (e.g. city) while a 'Load more' (page 2+) fetch is still in flight, the stale in-flight request's callback captures isFirstPage=false from its own closure and will append its (now filter-mismatched) results onto the freshly-replaced page-1 listings for the new filter, once it resolves after the new page-1 fetch completes. This is a pre-existing pattern in the codebase (no request cancellation/AbortController anywhere in fetchListings, before or after this change) rather than something newly introduced, and requires a specific timing window to trigger.
findings.evidence: rentals/frontend/src/app/browse/page.tsx:39-74 — no AbortController/request-id guard against out-of-order responses
